items.text: Bills ruled DJ Moore OUT Thursday night (shoulder); AC joint sprain, not serious, day-to-day with chance (not lock) for next week vs Chargers.
items.why: Landed hard on shoulder, X-rays, AC sprain confirmed.
items.implication: Missed TNF; monitor for Week 3. Short-term Bills WR vacuum.
items.opportunity: Targets to other Bills receivers in TNF.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs from Week 1 hit); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs, working sideline only, Harbaugh day-to-day but Schefter unlikely.
items.implication: Sit; boost to other Chargers WRs.
items.opportunity: 90%+ routes for Johnston/Harris in 4th without him Week 1.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight); if OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already IR/return (wrist).
items.opportunity: Target share spike for Bateman/Andrews without Flowers/Lane.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024); DNP Thursday, MRI results key, status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN. Week 1 routes: Collins 37/42 dropbacks, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27.
items.why: Hamstring strain (grade 1 per some reports), soft tissue history, consecutive DNPs/limited.
items.implication: High risk sit; contingency plans needed.
items.opportunity: Routes vacuum if OUT; every-down roles for backups.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to debut Sunday; unclear how much he eats into Rhamondre Stevenson but timing perfect—Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Full practice, self-reported ready; role expansion opportunity.
items.implication: Handcuff/lead potential; Stevenson snaps drop from 86%.

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday (knee surgery last week); yet to practice since procedure.
items.implication: Likely sit vs LAC; Mayer elevates.

items.text: Week 2 waivers: Ladd McConkey = Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane = Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown = Doubs/Douglas; Kamara = Kendre Miller; others like Vele for Tyson.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping for available players.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: home 21.3 PPG last year; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; DAL top-5 implied total in high-total game.
LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN despite tough W1: 27% targets, 13.7 aDOT/3 deep; TEN allows high catch rate/YPR, 6th-most PPG to WRs.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target rate on routes; IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes W1, 69% points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
items.why: Committee + return of Kamara + tough matchup/script.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% targets from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite target share + history + soft D.
